purpose: Explain Aegis Alpha capabilities, agent-native limits, API groups, and what remains usable without APIs.

first_run_brief: Aegis Alpha is a research-only investment workflow pack. It can help with market desk reviews, macro and theme analysis, equity screening, equity research, portfolio/risk review, paper-only trade planning, advice lifecycle tracking, quant validation, report review, and scheduled research workflows.
It never enables live trading, order execution, allocation authorization, or executable investment advice. All outputs remain research and evidence workflow outputs.

Full initialization requires the global market_data baseline. A-share and China market data use TUSHARE_TOKEN from https://tushare.pro. LongBridge / LongPort from https://open.longbridge.com/skill/ is preferred for supported Hong Kong, US, China, and account-enabled markets. Markets outside configured coverage, such as Japan, Korea, or Taiwan in some LongBridge setups, need exchange/company IR/public quote verification or a region-specific provider. Finnhub at https://finnhub.io is only a fallback where it covers the requested market.

Optional API groups unlock better search, document parsing, market intelligence, and external push. Each optional group can be configured, explicitly skipped, or disabled. Deferred choices keep initialization incomplete.
Prewarm seeds an initial auditable cache artifact after providers are configured. It is an installation/runtime health step, not a separate public user skill and not a recurring automation by itself.

Heartbeat is the recurring automation choice. It may create future prewarm or market review jobs, but only after the agent explains exact jobs, schedules, runtime location, and receives explicit approval.

Portfolio setup decides where holdings come from. The agent must ask whether current holdings exist and must fail closed for portfolio analysis until holdings are provided, imported, or connected through a read-only source.

configuration_matrix.unlocks: A-share, Hong Kong, US, supported overseas market data baseline; quotes; daily bars; historical series; screening and quant inputs; explicit identity verification routes for uncovered markets.
configuration_matrix.setup: Tushare TUSHARE_TOKEN at https://tushare.pro; LongBridge / LongPort at https://open.longbridge.com/skill/ for supported markets; Finnhub or region-specific providers for covered fallback markets; exchange/company IR/public quote pages for identity checks when APIs are unavailable.
configuration_matrix.completion_condition: TUSHARE_TOKEN is configured and either LongBridge/LongPort credentials, an authenticated LongBridge CLI session, or FINNHUB_API_KEY is available.
configuration_matrix.if_skipped: Aegis Alpha is not fully initialized. Market-sensitive workflows must stay in setup guidance or fail closed.

configuration_matrix.unlocks: Provider-backed source discovery, search expansion, and fresh research intake.
configuration_matrix.setup: Tavily at https://app.tavily.com or Qveris at https://qveris.ai/docs.
configuration_matrix.completion_condition: TAVILY_API_KEYS or QVERIS_API_KEY is configured, or the user explicitly skips/disables it.
configuration_matrix.if_skipped: Use agent-native web/search tools when available, or ask the user for source files and links.

configuration_matrix.unlocks: Provider-backed large PDF/report parsing and document evidence normalization.
configuration_matrix.completion_condition: MINERU_API_KEY is configured, or the user explicitly skips/disables it.
configuration_matrix.if_skipped: Use agent-native file/document reading for simple files, or ask the user for extracted text.

configuration_matrix.unlocks: Provider-backed market news, macro events, theme catalysts, and desk brief enrichment.
configuration_matrix.setup: Jin10 at https://www.jin10.com/, Tavily at https://app.tavily.com, or Qveris at https://qveris.ai/docs.
configuration_matrix.completion_condition: JIN10_API_KEY, TAVILY_API_KEYS, or QVERIS_API_KEY is configured, or the user explicitly skips/disables it.
configuration_matrix.if_skipped: Use agent-native search when available; fail closed if fresh evidence cannot be obtained.

configuration_matrix.required: optional, only if the user wants external delivery
configuration_matrix.unlocks: Confirmed Feishu report delivery and scheduled push workflows.
configuration_matrix.completion_condition: FEISHU_APP_ID, FEISHU_APP_SECRET, FEISHU_RECEIVE_ID, and FEISHU_CHAT_ID are configured, or the user explicitly skips/disables it.
configuration_matrix.if_skipped: External push is unavailable. Keep output in agent chat or workspace.

configuration_matrix.required: required only when cache_policy is prewarm-required; otherwise optional
configuration_matrix.unlocks: Initial auditable cache artifact and provider/runtime health check.
configuration_matrix.setup: Run the execution-automation prewarm command after market_data is configured.
configuration_matrix.completion_condition: A fresh prewarm artifact exists without critical gaps, or the user explicitly skips/accepts partial/defer according to policy.
configuration_matrix.if_skipped: No initial cache artifact. Workflows may need live evidence retrieval and must fail closed on stale or missing critical data.

configuration_matrix.required: operational choice required; automation itself is optional
configuration_matrix.unlocks: Recurring prewarm and market review jobs for selected desk modes.
configuration_matrix.setup: Use native Codex automations when available, or explain an OS scheduler fallback and ask for approval.
configuration_matrix.completion_condition: The user chooses none/manual/skip, or approves a real supported automation plan that has been created.
configuration_matrix.if_skipped: No recurring work. The user must ask the agent to run workflows manually.

configuration_matrix.unlocks: Holdings-aware portfolio review, risk checks, advice tracking, and paper-only trade planning.
configuration_matrix.setup: Choose none, manual-ledger, imported-file, or read-only-api; then provide holdings, import a file, or connect a read-only source.
configuration_matrix.completion_condition: The source is confirmed and holdings state is recorded as provided, imported, read_only_api, none_confirmed, or not_provided_fail_closed.
configuration_matrix.if_skipped: Portfolio analysis is unavailable or must fail closed until holdings are supplied.

step_prompt_templates.capabilities: First explain the first_run_brief and configuration_matrix in concise user-facing language. Then ask which product experience or preset the user wants to initialize.
step_prompt_templates.runtime_profile: Explain the preset choices and required axes: data_providers, cache_policy, manual_input, portfolio_source, heartbeat. Ask the user to choose or explicitly accept recommended defaults.
step_prompt_templates.market_data: Explain that market_data is globally required, list Tushare, LongBridge/LongPort, and Finnhub or region-specific fallback setup URLs, clarify that provider coverage is market/account specific, describe the completion condition, then ask whether to configure now or provide existing credentials.
step_prompt_templates.optional_api_groups: For each optional group, explain what it unlocks, setup URL, completion condition, and skipped behavior. Ask configure, skip/disable, or defer for one group at a time.
step_prompt_templates.prewarm: Explain that prewarm runs once to seed an initial auditable cache and check provider/runtime health. Ask whether to run it now, skip, accept partial, or defer.
step_prompt_templates.heartbeat: Explain none, manual, daily-prewarm, market-heartbeat, and full. If automation is requested, list exact jobs and schedules before asking for approval to create them.
step_prompt_templates.portfolio: Explain none, manual-ledger, imported-file, and read-only-api. Ask whether the user has current holdings and record provided/imported/read-only/none/fail-closed state.
step_prompt_templates.final_review: Summarize configured, skipped, deferred, and fail-closed items. Only say initialization is complete when init-guide returns initialized=true.

agent_native.label: Agent-native tools
can_do: Use the current agent's own web/search/browser/file/document tools when available.
Collect public evidence, inspect pages or filings, read local files, compare sources, and draft research outputs.
Run Aegis Alpha dispatch scripts and validate fail-closed contracts.
cannot_guarantee: Reliable structured market time series, fundamentals, or real-time quotes without a configured data feed.
External push delivery without the target service credentials.
Recurring wakeups unless the current agent exposes native automation.

skill_api.label: Configured skill APIs
can_do: Provide structured or provider-backed data for capabilities that need repeatable evidence.
Improve market data, news/search, document parsing, and external push workflows when matching API groups are configured.
cannot_guarantee: Investment decisions or live trading authorization.
Capabilities outside the configured API group.

workspace_cache.label: Workspace cache and prewarm artifacts
can_do: Reuse auditable evidence prepared by prewarm jobs.
Reduce repeated API or web calls for scheduled desk workflows.
cannot_guarantee: Fresh evidence when artifacts are missing or stale.
A substitute for missing critical data.

manual_input.label: User-supplied evidence
can_do: Let the user provide holdings, ledgers, reports, filings, or facts when configured acquisition channels cannot prove them.
cannot_guarantee: A fallback for external push, live trading, or missing critical evidence.

global_market_data.label: Global required market data baseline
unlocks: supported overseas market data via $longbridge / LongPort
market-specific identity verification routes for uncovered markets
global_market_data.required_when: Always required before Aegis Alpha is considered fully initialized.
global_market_data.without_api: Initialization must treat market data as missing. Do not run market-sensitive workflows as fully configured; only provide setup guidance or fail closed.

research_search.label: Research search and source discovery
research_search.required_when: The current agent lacks usable web/search tools or the user requests API-backed search.
research_search.without_api: Use agent-native search/browser tools when available, or ask the user for source files and links.

document_parse.label: Document parsing
document_parse.required_when: The task requires provider-backed parsing for complex PDFs or documents the current agent cannot read reliably.
document_parse.without_api: Use agent-native file/document reading for simple files, or ask the user for extracted text.

market_data.label: Structured market data
unlocks: supported overseas market data via $longbridge / LongPort
market-specific identity verification routes for uncovered markets
market_data.required_when: Always required as the global market-data baseline. A-share/China data should follow the $tushare skill token convention (`TUSHARE_TOKEN`). Hong Kong, US, China, and account-enabled markets should prefer the $longbridge / LongPort convention, either via `LONGPORT_APP_KEY`, `LONGPORT_APP_SECRET`, and `LONGPORT_ACCESS_TOKEN`, or via an authenticated LongBridge CLI session verified by `longbridge auth status`. Japan, Korea, Taiwan, or other markets outside configured coverage require exchange/company IR/public quote verification or a region-specific provider. `FINNHUB_API_KEY` is only a fallback where it covers the requested market.
market_data.without_api: Do not fabricate structured data. Initialization is incomplete until market_data is configured; market-sensitive workflows must fail closed or stay in setup guidance mode.

market_intel.label: Market news and macro intelligence
market_intel.required_when: The task needs provider-backed news feeds or broad market intelligence beyond agent-native search.
market_intel.without_api: Use agent-native search when available, cite sources, and fail closed if fresh evidence cannot be obtained.

external_push.label: External confirmed push
external_push.required_when: The user explicitly enables external-push=confirm-only and wants delivery outside the agent chat.
external_push.without_api: External push is unavailable. Do not degrade to manual input or silent sending.

one_off_research.label: One-off investment research
one_off_research.agent_native_fit: strong when the agent has web/search/file tools
one_off_research.without_api: Only setup guidance or source-reading dry runs are allowed until the global market_data baseline is configured.

market_desk.label: Market desk, macro, themes, and news
market_desk.agent_native_fit: useful for verification and fresh source inspection
market_desk.without_api: Requires the global market_data baseline; without it, stay in setup guidance or fail closed.

structured_screening_and_quant.label: Structured screening and quant validation
structured_screening_and_quant.agent_native_fit: limited; public pages are not a reliable structured dataset
structured_screening_and_quant.without_api: Requires user-provided dataset/cache or fails closed.

portfolio_review.label: Portfolio and position review
portfolio_review.agent_native_fit: strong for analyzing provided ledgers, holdings, and reports
portfolio_review.without_api: Manual ledgers can be inspected, but portfolio marks and risk review require the global market_data baseline.

report_review.label: Report review and outcome alignment
report_review.agent_native_fit: strong for local reports and cited evidence
report_review.without_api: Usable when reports and evidence are provided or readable by the agent.

external_push.label: External report push
external_push.agent_native_fit: not a substitute for service credentials
external_push.without_api: Unavailable; keep output in the agent chat or workspace.

quick-research.message: Market data is globally required. Configure Tushare for A-shares and LongBridge/LongPort for overseas markets first; add search or parsing APIs when agent-native evidence is insufficient.

daily-desk.message: Market desk workflows require the market_data baseline; market_intel is recommended for provider-backed news and macro events.

portfolio-desk.message: Portfolio review needs holdings from manual-ledger, imported-file, or read-only-api, and market_data is required for marks and time-series context.

report-review.message: Report review can inspect local reports, but Aegis Alpha still requires the market_data baseline before being fully initialized. Parsing/search APIs improve evidence coverage.

full-institutional.message: Full workflow requires the market_data baseline, then recommends market intelligence, search, parsing, and prewarm artifacts for repeatability.
